title: Rabanne marks 60th anniversary with The Warehouse Project club night which celebrates its ‘values'
summary: The Puig-owned luxury fashion and fragrance brand hosted a rave in Manchester with UK club series The Warehouse Project to celebrate its history of ‘challenging convention’, as well as showcase new night-themed scent, 1 Million Black
